# hpe_morpheus_cluster_affinity_group (Data Source)



## Example Usage - Name

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_cluster_affinity_group" "example" {
  name       = "default"
  cluster_id = 1
}
```

## Example Usage - Id

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_cluster_affinity_group" "example" {
  id         = 1
  cluster_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the parent cluster.

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the cluster affinity group.
- `name` (String) The name of the cluster affinity group.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Active
- `visibility` (String)
